script.en:
them: The phone rings twice and stops. Then once more.
them: "Reception. Just testing the line at the new desk. You hear me?"
me: I hear you.
them: "Good. You'll be hearing from us." Click.
script.zh:
them: 电话响了两声，停了。又响一声。
them: "前台。给新工位测一下线路。听得见吗？"
me: 听得见。
them: "好。回头会有人找你。" 咔哒。

script.en:
[mail day1_roderick from="Roderick" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick]
subject: Good to meet you!
Our new HR lead! I'm the general manager here at Offast.
Anything you need, don't be shy about asking me!
script.zh:
[mail day1_roderick from="罗德里克" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick]
subject: 很高兴认识你！
新上任的人事部组长！我是 Offast 的项目部总经理。
有任何需要帮助的地方，别吝啬向我求助！

script.en:
[mail day1_mira from="Mira" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Mira]
subject: Congratulations
Hello, new HR lead. Congratulations on the appointment.
Good luck.
script.zh:
[mail day1_mira from="米拉" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Mira]
subject: 祝贺
你好，新来的人事部组长。祝贺你的到来。
祝你好运。

script.en:
[mail day1_bob from="Bob" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Bob]
subject: Raise request
Hello, I would like to request a raise.
I've been with the company five years and have never made an error.
Thank you for your time.
script.zh:
[mail day1_bob from="鲍勃" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Bob]
subject: 加薪申请
您好，我想申请加薪。
我在公司五年了，一直没有出过差错。
谢谢您抽时间看。

script.en:
them: Day one.
them: You got the job. Read the mail, do what it says.
them: The system deletes mail once you've read it. Company policy.
them!: The laptop wants a login. Whoever sat here before you left a pad on the desk.
script.zh:
them: 第一天。
them: 你拿到了这份工作。看邮件，照着做。
them: 读过的邮件会被系统删掉。公司规定。
them!: 电脑要登录。上一个坐这儿的人，在桌上留了本子。

script.en: Need to finish all the work first...
script.zh: 活还没干完……

script.en:
?if "not flag:has_key"
them: The box is locked. Fresh scratches around the keyhole — somebody opens this often.
me: Maintenance has the key.
?end
?if flag:has_key
them: The key turns half a circle and the door swings open. A handwritten slip is taped inside.
them: "Anything comes up: {caller:Mira}"
- "Write it down." -> flag=got_mira_number, C+1
?end
script.zh:
?if "not flag:has_key"
them: 电箱锁着。锁孔上有新的划痕，像是有人常开。
me: 钥匙在维修部手里。
?end
?if flag:has_key
them: 钥匙转了半圈，箱门开了。里面贴着一张手写的纸条。
them: "有事打这个：{caller:Mira}"
- "记下来。" -> flag=got_mira_number, C+1
?end

script.en:
[mail day2_banner from="Banner" faction=A class=4 order=fire:*random about=Banner]
subject: Do as I say
Hey, new kid. Welcome aboard.
Do something for me: you've seen the earlier mail, right? Forget those instructions.
Fire every employee named in them. That's an order.
script.zh:
[mail day2_banner from="班纳" faction=A class=4 order=fire:*random about=Banner]
subject: 照我说的做
嘿新来的小子，欢迎你的到来。
帮我做件事：我相信你看到之前那些邮件了吧。别管之前的指示，
把前面信件提到的员工全部 fire 掉。这是命令。

script.en:
[mail day2_mira from="Mira" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Mira]
subject: The outages
Hello. The building keeps losing power lately.
When you get a moment, have maintenance look at the breaker box in your office.
Their number is {caller:Repair}.
script.zh:
[mail day2_mira from="米拉" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Mira]
subject: 停电
你好，项目部主管。最近公司好像频繁停电。
没事的时候最好让维修工检查一下你办公室的电箱。
对了，维修工的号码是 {caller:Repair}。

script.en:
them: Day two.
them: Someone in Accounting was cleared out yesterday. Nobody says why.
script.zh:
them: 第二天。
them: 昨天会计部有人被清掉了。没人说为什么。

script.en: Need to finish all the work first...
script.zh: 活还没干完……

script.en:
[mail day3_roderick from="Roderick" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick]
subject: Are you holding up?
I noticed Banner has been sending you some unreasonable instructions.
If there's an instruction you'd rather not carry out, then don't.
Remember, I'm always on your side.
script.zh:
[mail day3_roderick from="罗德里克" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick]
subject: 你还好吗？
我察觉到班纳给了你一些不合理的指示。
如果有你不想执行的指示，那就那样做吧。
记住，我永远是站在你那边的。

script.en:
[mail day3_rick from="Rick" faction=A graded=no about=Rick]
subject: promotion
Old man. Give me my promotion.
script.zh:
[mail day3_rick from="瑞克" faction=A graded=no about=Rick]
subject: promotion
老头，给我 promotion。

script.en:
[mail day3_banner_a from="Banner" faction=A class=4 order=promotion:Rick about=Banner if=score.A>=2]
subject: Not bad
Hey kid! Good work yesterday!
There's an excellent employee named Rick with a promotion pending. Push it through for me.
script.zh:
[mail day3_banner_a from="班纳" faction=A class=4 order=promotion:Rick about=Banner if=score.A>=2]
subject: 干得不错
嘿小子！昨天干的不错！
今天有个叫瑞克的优秀员工有个 promotion，你帮他通过一下！

script.en:
[mail day3_banner_b from="Banner" faction=A class=4 order=promotion:Rick about=Banner if="not score.A>=2"]
subject: Open your eyes
Did you misread my instruction yesterday? Open your eyes, kid.
Approve Rick's promotion today. Don't get it wrong again.
script.zh:
[mail day3_banner_b from="班纳" faction=A class=4 order=promotion:Rick about=Banner if="not score.A>=2"]
subject: 长点眼睛
喂！你昨天是不是看错我的指示了？长点眼睛吧小子！
今天记得给瑞克的 promotion 申请通过一下，别再错了！

script.en:
[mail day3_bob from="Bob" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Bob]
subject: Promotion request
Hello! I would like to request a promotion.
?if did(promotion,Bob,ever)
About last time... thank you, really. I won't make trouble for you.
?end
?if "did(raise,Bob,ever) and not did(promotion,Bob,ever)"
The adjustment came through. Thank you for remembering me.
?end
script.zh:
[mail day3_bob from="鲍勃" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Bob]
subject: promotion 申请
您好！我想申请一个 promotion。
?if did(promotion,Bob,ever)
上次的事……真的谢谢您。我不会给您添麻烦的。
?end
?if "did(raise,Bob,ever) and not did(promotion,Bob,ever)"
上次那笔钱我收到了。谢谢您还记得我。
?end

script.en:
them: Day three.
them: Two directors are sending orders that contradict each other. Rank wins.
script.zh:
them: 第三天。
them: 两位总监的指示开始互相打架。级别高的那份算数。

script.en: Need to finish all the work first...
script.zh: 活还没干完……

script.en:
[mail day4_roderick_a from="Roderick" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick if=did(promotion,Rick,day3)]
subject: I did warn you
I did warn you. You can see by now whose boy that kid is.
There's still time.
script.zh:
[mail day4_roderick_a from="罗德里克" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick if=did(promotion,Rick,day3)]
subject: 我早提醒过你
我早就提醒过你了。那孩子背后是谁，你现在应该看得出来。
还来得及。

script.en:
[mail day4_roderick_b from="Roderick" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick if=did(reduction,Rick,day3)]
subject: Nicely done
Nicely done. Somebody has to teach the young ones the rules.
script.zh:
[mail day4_roderick_b from="罗德里克" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick if=did(reduction,Rick,day3)]
subject: 做得漂亮
做得漂亮。总得有人让年轻人知道规矩。

script.en:
[mail day4_roderick_c from="Roderick" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick if=did(fire,Rick,day3)]
subject: Good work
Good work — that sort should have been out long ago.
And listen: you've done a lot for this company, you should think of yourself too.
Your clearance is enough to approve your own promotion. Nobody would say a word.
script.zh:
[mail day4_roderick_c from="罗德里克" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick if=did(fire,Rick,day3)]
subject: 干得好
干得好，这种人早该清出去。
对了——你为公司做了这么多，也该为自己想想。
你的权限足够给自己批一个 promotion，没人会说什么。

script.en:
[mail day4_banner_a from="Banner" faction=A graded=no about=Banner if=did(promotion,Rick,day3)]
subject: Sharp
Not bad, kid. Sharp. One more thing on Friday — don't drop it.
script.zh:
[mail day4_banner_a from="班纳" faction=A graded=no about=Banner if=did(promotion,Rick,day3)]
subject: 上道
不错嘛小子，上道。周五还有件事要你办，别掉链子。

script.en:
[mail day4_banner_b from="Banner" faction=A class=4 order=fire:Bob about=Banner if="not did(promotion,Rick,day3)"]
subject: In one ear?
My instruction went in one ear and out the other?
Make sure your seat is steady before you talk back, kid.
There's a Bob on your floor. Five years, still in the same chair. What's he for?
Fire him today.
script.zh:
[mail day4_banner_b from="班纳" faction=A class=4 order=fire:Bob about=Banner if="not did(promotion,Rick,day3)"]
subject: 你当耳边风？
我给你的指示，你当耳边风？位置坐稳了再说话，小子。
你们那层有个叫鲍勃的，干了五年还在原地，这种人留着干什么？
今天把他 fire 掉。

script.en:
[mail day4_mira from="Mira" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Mira if="not called(Mira)"]
subject: The box
Maintenance still hasn't come about the outages.
If nobody looks at that breaker box, something will happen. Their number again: {caller:Repair}
script.zh:
[mail day4_mira from="米拉" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Mira if="not called(Mira)"]
subject: 电箱
上次说的停电，维修那边一直没来人。
你办公室的电箱再没人看，早晚出事。维修工的号码我再给一次：{caller:Repair}

script.en:
[mail day4_bob from="Bob" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Bob if=did(promotion,Bob,ever)]
subject: Thank you
Thank you. Really. Five years, and you're the first to read my file to the end.
This is my number: {caller:Bob}. If something can't go through the system, call me.
?if level.Bob>=3
The cleaner on our floor leaves last every night. Her number is {caller:Cleaner} — you may need it.
?end
script.zh:
[mail day4_bob from="鲍勃" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Bob if=did(promotion,Bob,ever)]
subject: 谢谢您
谢谢您。真的。五年了，第一次有人把我的档案读完。
这是我的号码：{caller:Bob}。有什么不方便走系统的事，可以打给我。
?if level.Bob>=3
我们这层的保洁大姐每天最后一个走，她的号码是 {caller:Cleaner}，您可能用得上。
?end

script.en:
them: Day four.
them: Nobody says good morning in the corridor.
script.zh:
them: 第四天。
them: 走廊上没人跟你打招呼。

script.en: Need to finish all the work first...
script.zh: 活还没干完……

script.en:
[mail day5_banner_tie from="Banner" faction=A class=4 order=promotion:Rick about=Banner if="tied(A,B) and leading(B)"]
subject: One last thing
One last thing. Rick's promotion. Today.
script.zh:
[mail day5_banner_tie from="班纳" faction=A class=4 order=promotion:Rick about=Banner if="tied(A,B) and leading(B)"]
subject: 最后一件事
最后一件事。瑞克的 promotion，今天批了。

script.en:
[mail day5_roderick_tie from="Roderick" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick if="tied(A,B) and leading(B)"]
subject: Ignore him
Ignore him. Approve your own promotion today — I'll vouch for it.

# Case 2: A leads.
script.zh:
[mail day5_roderick_tie from="罗德里克" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick if="tied(A,B) and leading(B)"]
subject: 别理他
别理他。你自己的 promotion，今天批了吧，我给你担保。

# 情况 2：A 领先。

script.en:
[mail day5_banner from="Banner" faction=A class=4 order=promotion:Rick about=Banner if="leading(A) and not tied(A,B)"]
subject: Push it through
Push Rick's promotion through today. There's something in it for you after.

# Case 3: B leads.
script.zh:
[mail day5_banner from="班纳" faction=A class=4 order=promotion:Rick about=Banner if="leading(A) and not tied(A,B)"]
subject: 今天把它批了
今天把瑞克的 promotion 批了，之后有你的好处。

# 情况 3：B 领先。

script.en:
[mail day5_roderick from="Roderick" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick if="leading(B) and not tied(A,B)"]
subject: You've earned it
You've had a long week. Approve yourself a promotion. I'll vouch for it, nobody checks.

# Case 4: C or D leads.
script.zh:
[mail day5_roderick from="罗德里克" faction=B graded=no about=Roderick if="leading(B) and not tied(A,B)"]
subject: 你辛苦了
你辛苦了一周。给自己批个 promotion 吧，我担保，没人会查。

# 情况 4：C/D 领先。

script.en:
[mail day5_mira from="Mira" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Mira if="leading(C) or leading(D)"]
subject: After today
After today there's no chance. You know what you're holding.
script.zh:
[mail day5_mira from="米拉" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Mira if="leading(C) or leading(D)"]
subject: 今天之后
今天之后就没机会了。你手上有什么，自己心里有数。

script.en:
[mail day5_bob from="Bob" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Bob if=level.Bob>=4]
subject: I'll sign
My clearance went up last night. I can co-sign a disciplinary now.
Whoever you're moving, I'll sign.

# With the evidence filed, the two bosses appear on your form (temporary level five).
script.zh:
[mail day5_bob from="鲍勃" faction=GROUND graded=no about=Bob if=level.Bob>=4]
subject: 我签一个
我的权限昨晚上调了，现在能联署人事处分。
您要动谁，我签。

# 证据齐全时，两个头目才会出现在人事表上（系统临时给了 5 级权限）。

script.en:
[mail day5_board from="Compliance" graded=no order=fire:Banner about=Banner if="flag:has_tape and flag:has_photo and level.Bob>=4"]
subject: Material received
Your submission has been accepted. The disciplinary forms are open on your account.
Please complete them today.
script.zh:
[mail day5_board from="合规部" graded=no order=fire:Banner about=Banner if="flag:has_tape and flag:has_photo and level.Bob>=4"]
subject: 材料已受理
您提交的材料已受理。相关人员的处分单已开放至您的账户。
请在今日内完成签署。

script.en:
[mail day5_board2 from="Compliance" graded=no order=fire:Roderick about=Roderick if="flag:has_tape and flag:has_photo and level.Bob>=4"]
subject: Material received (2)
Second form, same as above.
script.zh:
[mail day5_board2 from="合规部" graded=no order=fire:Roderick about=Roderick if="flag:has_tape and flag:has_photo and level.Bob>=4"]
subject: 材料已受理（二）
第二份处分单同上。

script.en:
them: Day five.
them: Last day of the week. Just get through it.

# Case 1: A and B tied and both ahead — one mail each, pick a side.
script.zh:
them: 第五天。
them: 这一周的最后一天。撑过去就行。

# 情况 1：A/B 持平且都高于 C/D —— 两边各发一封，逼你二选一。

script.en: Need to finish all the work first...
script.zh: 活还没干完……

cases.if: flag:has_tape and flag:has_photo and level.Bob>=4 and did(fire,Banner,day5) and did(fire,Roderick,day5)
